t: Tali HQ is an app where you run your life and your business with Tali, an AI with a brain that grows with you. You chat to her like you would message a mate who never forgets. She keeps your people, your lists, your dates and your money in order, drafts your messages, emails and invoices, writes you a morning brief and helps you close the day. Everything worth keeping becomes a memory in her brain, so you never explain yourself twice. One rule sits under everything: Tali never sends, spends or changes anything without your yes. Anything she writes to go out waits on your Today screen until you tap it. See Approvals . Today, the first screen you see each time you open Tali HQ

Life, business or both # When you set up, Tali asks "Do you run a business?". Say yes and you get clients, leads, invoices, receipts and rules as well as everything for your own life. Say "No, just me" and she keeps to your life: people, money, health and goals. You can switch it any time in Settings , and nothing is deleted when you do.

Where to use it # Tali HQ runs in your browser on iPhone, Android and computer at talihq.com.au . On your phone, open it in your browser and add it to your home screen, and it works like any other app. Your account, chats and data are the same on every device.

The plans # Every new account starts with a free 7 day trial of Tali HQ. No card needed. When the trial ends you drop to Free unless you choose a plan. Full details are on Plans, credits and billing . There is also Tali HQ Business at A$199.99 a month, for running a business from one place. It has everything in Tali HQ Max plus jobs and quotes, a pipeline, bookings and projects , a hosted website , and On autopilot and the bookkeeping pack . Finding your way around # Five tabs sit along the bottom of the app. Today : her brain with your day around it as stars. What's due, drafts waiting for your yes, your brief and your numbers. See Today and your morning brief . Talk : chat with Tali. See Talk to Tali . Her brain : everything she knows about you, sorted by the part of the brain it lives in. Her library and what she tidied overnight are here too. See Her brain . Your world : your life on one map, in six parts: People, Work, Health, Home and money, Growth and Your words. Every list, screen and tool opens from here. See Your world . Me : your plan and credits, top ups, Settings, and your own copy of her brain to download or share. See Settings and account .

Best first steps # Make your account and confirm your email. See Getting started . Open Talk and tell Tali three things: who matters to you, what's on your plate this week, and one thing you keep forgetting. Tell her about a few people ("Mum's birthday is 14 December", "Priya Nair is a new client, follow up Friday"). On the trial or a paid plan, send your Gmail to Tali or connect Outlook from Your world , Email , and connect your calendar in Me , Settings , Connections . See Gmail and Outlook . Pick your morning brief time in Settings . Tali says Tell me the boring stuff too. Who's slack at paying, when the rego's due, what you're sick of doing. That's where I earn my keep.

Questions # Do I need Totality or Totality Nutrition to use Tali HQ? No. Tali HQ is its own app with its own sign up. If you do use Totality or Totality Nutrition, you can link the account from Her brain so you don't have to tell Tali the same things twice. See Her brain . Do I need a business to use Tali HQ? No. Answer "No, just me" when Tali asks and she looks after your life: people, dates, lists, money, health and goals. Is Tali a real person? No. Tali is an AI. She drafts and suggests, and anything she wants to send, spend or change waits for your yes. Is there an App Store or Google Play version? Use Tali HQ in your browser at talihq.com.au and add it to your home screen. It works on iPhone, Android and computer. The App Store and Google Play versions are on their way. Who makes Tali HQ? Totality 360, the Australian team behind Totality and Totality Nutrition. How do I get help? Read Troubleshooting and the FAQ , or email admintotality@gmail.com and a real person will help.

t: Setting up takes about two minutes. You make an account, tap the link in the email Tali sends you, answer a few questions about you, and she shows you around.

Make your account # Make your account Check your email Open talihq.com.au in your browser. On your phone, you can add it to your home screen first (in Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen ; in Chrome tap the menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app ). Tap New here? Make an account . Fill in First name , Email and Password . Your password needs at least 8 characters. Tap Make my account . The Check your email screen appears. Open the email from Tali HQ and tap the link to confirm your address. Come back to Tali HQ and sign in with your email and password. Your 7 day free trial of Tali HQ starts the moment the account is made. No card needed. Trial Email not there? Check your junk or spam folder. Still nothing after a few minutes? Tap Resend email . If you typed the wrong address, tap Wrong email? Start again and fill the form in again.

Sign in # Sign in Type your Email and Password and tap Sign in . If you forget your password, type your email in the box first, then tap Forgot password . Tali emails you a link to set a new one. See Troubleshooting if you get stuck.

Meet Tali # The first time you sign in, Tali asks you a few things, one question to a screen. It takes about a minute. What should I call you? What would you like a hand with? What should I call you? Check your First name . This is what Tali calls you. What would you like a hand with? Tap as many as you like, for example My week and to-dos, Health and habits, The people in my life or Big goals. You can change it later. Do you run a business? Tap yes or No, just me . If you do, add your Business name (optional) and tap the closest match under What kind of business : Personal trainer, Gym or studio, Coach or consultant, Trades, Health and beauty, Online business or Something else. Anything I should know from day one? Write a line or two in your own words, up to 1,000 characters. For example, "I'm hopeless at follow-ups, I want to be in bed by ten, and Mum's birthday is in December." It's optional, and everything you tell her becomes a memory in her brain. Can I tap you on the shoulder? Tali lists the only things she sends: your morning brief, reminders you asked for, and things worth knowing, like when an invoice gets paid. Your morning brief Tali HQ # Every morning at the time you pick, Tali writes your brief: what's on your calendar and the free gaps (when connected), emails that need you, reminders and follow-ups due, unpaid or overdue invoices, anything in your business health worth a look, what's waiting for your yes, today's training session if you have a plan, and one nudge. The brief opened on Today Tap Read your morning brief under her brain. It shows once today's brief has landed. The brief opens with its headline and the first three lines. Tap Show all to see the rest. Tap Got it once you've read it. It then counts as read. Hide your brief folds it away without marking it read. Pick your brief time in Me , Settings , under Morning brief time : any half hour from 5:30am to 9:00am. Each brief uses 1 credit. On the Free plan Free has no daily brief. You get a Friday check-in from Tali instead, at the time set under Morning brief time . It appears under More from Tali , Earlier notes . Free
She learned this week # When Tali has kept new memories in the last week, a She learned this week card lists the newest ones. Tap Everything she knows to open her brain.

t: An idea from night school Pro # After a night of study, Tali may leave one idea on Today under AN IDEA FROM NIGHT SCHOOL , with why she thinks it suits you. Tap Let's try it to open Talk with the idea ready and save it to her brain, or Not for me to hide it. See Night school and Rules .

Needs you # Anything Tali has drafted for you, like a message, an email, an invoice or a booking, waits here. Tap a draft to open it, then copy it, send it, ask Tali to rework it, or tap Not needed . Full details are on Approvals . When an email needs you (forwarded from your Gmail, from Outlook, or sent to Tali's own address on Pro), a card at the top of this section says who it's from. Tap it to open Email. See Gmail and Outlook . Tali HQ

Due today Free # Reminders and client follow-ups that are due today (or overdue) show here. Due today with two reminders and a follow-up Tap the circle to tick a reminder or follow-up off. Under a reminder, tap Tomorrow to move it to 9am tomorrow, or Delete to remove it. Delete asks "Sure?" first, so tap again to confirm. Tap a follow-up to open that person. See Your people and dates . Add a reminder yourself # Adding a reminder Tap + Add a reminder under Due today. Type what to remind you about, for example "Chase Lou about his invoice". Pick a time: In an hour , This arvo (3pm, or an hour from now if it's already past 3), Tomorrow 9am , Monday 9am or Next week . Tap Remind me . Adding reminders yourself is free and uses no credits. You can also just tell Tali in Talk: "remind me to call Zack on Friday at 10". If notifications are on, Tali sends a short notification when a reminder is due.

At a glance # Up to four tiles with one number each. Tap a tile to slide its full card up from the bottom, and tap Close to put it away. At a glance A tile opened Money Tali HQ : what's late, or your runway, or cash in this month. See Money . Health Tali HQ : your business health. Only shows if you run a business. "All good" or how many things need a look. See below. This week Tali HQ : how many of your three promises for the week are done, or that your weekly review is due. See Goals and weekly review . Goals Tali HQ : how far along your first goal is. Tiles only show when there is something in them. Business health Tali HQ # Tali checks your business for these, every time you open Today: invoices that are overdue (red once the oldest is more than 14 days late) client follow-ups that are overdue (red when there are more than 3) active clients with no contact in 2 weeks new leads with no follow-up set after 2 days drafts waiting for your yes more than 2 days reminders overdue by more than a day Twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening (Sydney time), if anything is amber or red, Tali sends you one notification about it (at most once every 12 hours).

More from Tali # The quieter things live in a row of chips at the bottom. Tap one to open it. More from Tali, with Your day open Calendar Tali HQ : today's events and free gaps from your connected Google or Outlook calendar. Your day Free : food, training and weight. See Food and training . Tali noticed Pro : this month's patterns. See Her brain . Decisions Free : your latest decision. See Decisions . Earlier notes Free : older briefs, health checks and Friday check-ins. Tap one to read it in full. Meeting nudge Tali HQ # With a calendar connected, if one of today's events matches a client (their email is on the invite, or their name is in the title), Today shows "Meeting" with that person, the time, and the top things Tali knows about them.

In the evening # From two hours before your shutdown time, a Shut the day down card appears on Today with Start . The sky behind the app also changes through the day: lighter by day, fading into her night sky over the two hours before your shutdown time. Once the day is closed, Today is only her brain, turning slowly, her goodnight line, and two buttons: Sleep sounds and Write in your journal . Your lists come back in the morning. See Shut the day down and night mode .

t: If you told Tali you have a business, Today and Your world have a Business / Life switch at the top. Each side shows its own things, and the other side shows a count so you can see when something is waiting there. Today in Business Today in Life

What each side shows # Business : money, your pipeline and your business tools, with the work parts of Your world. Life : habits, what is coming up and money left this week, with the life parts of Your world. Her brain stays at the top of Today on both sides, and your people are in both. If you do not have a business, there is no switch and Today looks the way it always has.

Tali sorts things for you # Tali gives each reminder, list item and line of your brief a side, so work things show in Business and the rest shows in Life. This costs no credits. On To do, Ideas, Learning, Wins and Someday you can change which side an item belongs to, or filter by Everything.

Switch by the clock # In Settings , turn on Switch by the clock . Pick when work starts and ends and which days you work. Tali HQ opens on Business in your work hours and on Life the rest of the time. You can still switch by hand whenever you like, and your choice holds until work next starts or ends. Over the same two hours, the sky behind the app fades from its daytime blue into her night sky. The Tonight card on Today in the evening If Nudge me to shut down is on in Settings, Tali also sends one notification at your shutdown time if the day isn't closed yet. You can start a shutdown any time from Your world , Growth , Shut down .

t: Do your shutdown # How did today go? Tomorrow's three Tap Start on the Tonight card (or open it from Your world). Under How did today go? , tap one: Rough, Meh, Fine, Good or Great. You have to pick one. In One thing that went well , write something. Even a small one counts. Anything on your mind (optional) : get it out of your head. Check Tomorrow's three . Tali fills these in from what's due tomorrow and this week's commitments. Change any line, or clear it. Line 1 is the one thing that matters most; 2 and 3 are optional. Tap Done . Tali then: saves your answers, and puts "what went well" and your note into your journal as an entry called Shutdown (skipped if both are empty) turns each of tomorrow's three into a reminder at 9am tomorrow (lines that already match an open reminder are skipped) writes you one short sign off line The shutdown uses 1 credit on the trial and paid plans. On Free it counts as one of your 250 messages.

t: Talk is where you chat with Tali. Write to her like you'd message a mate who never forgets. She answers, and from the same message she can remember a birthday, add something to a list, set a reminder, draft a message, log your lunch or a spend, or add a client.

Start a chat # Tap Talk at the bottom. A brand new chat shows four starters: Help me plan my week , Write a follow-up for a client who went quiet , Give me 3 post ideas for this week and What should I focus on to grow? Tap one to put it in the box, or type your own. A new chat A chat in progress Type in the Message Tali box. A message can be up to 2,000 characters. Tap Send . While Tali works, the line under her name says Thinking... . Her reply appears on a dark panel. Long replies have a Copy link. If she did something as well, a short line above the box says what, for example "Draft waiting on Today, reminder set, saved 1 thing to remember." What shows under a reply # Small pills under Tali's reply tell you what she kept, and each one is a button. New memory : she saved something to her brain. Tap it to open Her brain at the group it was filed under, like "How you like things". Saved to your lists : she added to a list, ticked something off or marked a habit done. Tap it to open that list. See Your lists . Spend logged : she logged personal spending, with the total. Tap it to open Money on the Personal side. See Money . Tali HQ The line under the chat says what Tali did

t: What Tali can do from a message # Just ask in plain words. She only does these when you ask. Remember things Free : facts about you, your business, people and preferences. Up to three new things per message. See Her brain . Draft messages and posts Free : texts, follow-ups, social posts. They wait on Today for you to copy and send. See Approvals . Keep track of your people Free : family, friends, clients and leads, with birthdays. "Mum's birthday is 14 December", or "Zack Donaldson is a new lead, follow up Thursday." See Your people and dates . Add to your lists Free : to do, check ups, life admin, jobs around the house, habits, learning, wins, someday and ideas. "Add to my to do: send the quote to Mia by Friday", "Car rego is due 29 November, every year", "I read my 20 pages today." Lists use no extra credits. See Your lists . Set reminders Free : "remind me to ring Lou at 4pm tomorrow". With no time given, she uses 9am on that day. Log a decision Free : "I've decided to raise PT to $90 from January because costs are up." See Decisions . Log food, weight and training, and write you a programme Free : see Food and training . Draft an invoice Tali HQ : "invoice Priya for 4 PT sessio

Think harder # Above the message box is Think harder . Tap it to send your next message to a smarter Tali who brings more of her memory to the answer. Tap Quick answers to go back to normal. Think harder, with Deep think and Second opinion Deep think : for questions that need real thought. About half a minute. 20 credits. Tali HQ On Free you get 1 Deep think a month. Big brain : her strongest thinking, for the big calls. About a minute. 40 credits. Pro Second opinion : Tali answers, then a second AI checks her. Under her reply you see where it Agrees and what it Would change . 20 credits. Tali HQ Second opinion and video only show once they're switched on for your account. On the Plans screen, anything not switched on yet says Coming soon . On Max, all three cost half the credits for your first 100 a month. Replies show a SHE THOUGHT HARDER or BIG BRAIN label. If a turn fails, the credits come back. Sometimes, on a big question, Tali's normal reply ends with a Deep think this button. Tap it to ask the same question again with Deep think.

Voice notes Tali HQ # Tap the microphone next to the message box, say it, and tap the red dot to stop. A voice note can be up to 3 minutes. Tali turns it into text and answers as normal. Each voice note uses 1 credit. Tali HQ and the trial include 30 minutes of voice notes a month. Pro and Max have no cap.

Your chats # Tali remembers you across every chat, so starting a new one never loses anything she knows about you. Each chat still keeps its own history. New chat : tap it at the top right to start fresh. It only shows once the current chat has a message in it. Chats : opens Your chats , with pinned chats first, then the rest, newest first. Your chats Rename, pin or delete a chat In Your chats : Tap a chat to open it. Tap the three dots (or press and hold a chat) for Rename , Pin or Unpin , and Delete . Rename : type the new name and press enter, or tap away. Delete asks "Delete this chat for good?". Tap Delete to confirm or Keep to stop. Deleting removes the chat and any files you sent in it. What Tali has already remembered from it stays until you forget it in Her brain.

If a message doesn't send # If Tali can't be reached, your message shows Not sent. Try again and your words (and any files) go back in the box so nothing is lost. Tap Try again to resend it. A message that didn't send Other messages you might see: "That's your 250 free messages for this month. Upgrade to Tali HQ to keep chatting." Free "You've used this month's Tali credits. They top up on the 1st, or you can move up a plan." Tali HQ "Easy, tiger. Give me a minute and try again." You sent more than 20 things to Tali in 5 minutes. Wait a minute.

Ask Tali from other screens # Some screens have an Ask Tali , Tell Tali or Talk to Tali button: a person's page, a goal, a decision, any list, Body and Money. It opens Talk with a ready question in the box. Check it, change it if you like, and tap Send .

Share things to Tali # When Tali HQ is added to your home screen on Android, it shows up in your phone's share menu. Share a text, a link or a caption to Tali HQ and it lands in the Talk box as "Someone sent me this. What should I do with it?" with what you shared. Nothing sends until you tap Send .

How much a message costs # Free Each message counts as one of your 250 messages a month. Tali HQ Pro Each message uses 1 credit. A message with photos or a PDF uses 1 extra credit. Each web search uses 2 extra credits. Deep think is 20, Big brain 40, a second opinion 20, and a video 5 for each started minute. When a paid plan runs out of credits, Talk shows a Top up button. See Plans, credits and billing . If something goes wrong on Tali's side, the credit is given back. See Plans, credits and billing .

Questions # Does Tali remember what I said in another chat? Yes. What she learns about you goes into her memory of you, which she uses in every chat. Inside a chat she also reads the last 20 messages. Tali got something wrong about me. How do I fix it? Tell her in Talk ("actually, Priya trains Tuesdays"), or open Her brain , find the memory and fix or forget it. What is the difference between Deep think and Big brain? Both send your message to a stronger Tali with more of her memory. Deep think takes about half a minute and costs 20 credits. Big brain is her strongest thinking, takes about a minute, costs 40 credits and is on Pro and Max. Can I edit a message after I send it? No. Send a follow-up message with the correction and Tali will use it. Why didn't Tali search the web? Web search is on every plan: 10 searches a month on Free, and up to 150, 400 or 1,000 a month on Tali HQ, Pro and Max, at 2 credits each. t: Tali remembers what you tell her so you never explain yourself twice. Everything she keeps about you lives in her brain, filed by the kind of memory it is. It is private to you. You can read every memory, fix its words, mark it private, make her forget it, and download the lot. Free Tap Her brain at the bottom of the app. Her brain

What's on the screen # From the top: WHILE YOU SLEPT : what she learnt and tidied overnight, with an undo. Only shows after a night she had something to do. What she knows, in groups : Your people, How you like things, Your life and work, Plans and ideas, and What she has learned. Tap a group to open it, tap a memory to read it in full, and tap to see 10 more. Use Totality too? : link your Totality or Totality Nutrition account. Her library : the books she is reading. See Tali's library . Search her brain : type a name, a client or a topic. The brain itself , turning slowly, with every part as a chip underneath. TALI'S LEVEL , New this week and Connections .

The brain # The whole brain A part opened Every dot is something she knows. The more she keeps in a part, the brighter it glows. Drag sideways to spin her. A flick keeps her turning. Pinch with two fingers to zoom in and out. On a computer, a trackpad pinch works too. Tap a part , or its name underneath, to see what she keeps there. Tap Whole brain to see every part lit up at once. Each part holds a different kind of memory: Part What Tali keeps there Frontal lobe Rules and preferences she sticks to Prefrontal cortex Plans, ideas, your live goals and open decisions Parietal lobe What she can sense: your email and calendar Temporal lobe The people in your world Occipital lobe What she saw in photos you sent, and the images she made for you Cerebellum Lessons and mistakes Hippocampus Facts and events Amygdala Anything urgent, and contradictions for you to settle Basal ganglia Skills and routines she has learned Hypothalamus Her schedule: morning brief, health checks, shutdown, night school Corpus callosum The shared brain every Tali learns from, with no personal details The thalamus and brainstem are counted too. t: Fix, forget or keep a memory private # On any memory of yours in a part: Forget , then Sure? : it is gone for good. Private : stops this one memory being used for the shared brain. Change the words under Fix this memory and tap Save . A memory you fix yourself is one she trusts over her own version. You can also forget things about one person from their page: open them in Your people and tap Forget this under What Tali knows . Tali HQ See Your people and dates . When two memories disagree # If something new contradicts something she already knew, both show in the Amygdala under These two disagree . Tap Keep new , Keep old or Both true .

While you slept # Each night, for anyone who told her something new that day, Tali tidies her memories of you. Repeats are put together, a newer fact replaces the older one it updates, and small stale notes are let go. It uses no credits. What she tidied overnight The next day, the WHILE YOU SLEPT card at the top of Her brain says what she learnt and how many notes she tidied. Tap Show me to see each change, marked Said twice , Updated , Put together or Let go , with what it was before. Tap Undo on any one to put it back. Nothing is ever deleted: undo puts a note back exactly as it was. She never tidies anything urgent, anything you fixed yourself, or anything waiting on you to settle.
Search her brain # Type two or more letters in Search her brain . Up to 12 matches show, each with the part it lives in. Tap one to open that part.

Use Totality too? # If you use Totality or Totality Nutrition, you can link the account so you don't have to tell Tali the same things twice. On Her brain, find the Use Totality too? card and tap Link Totality . Type Your Totality email and Your Totality password . Tap Bring it across . What comes across: the goals and training preferences you picked at sign-up, and your plan. Nothing else. Your password is used once to prove it's you and is never kept. It only goes one way, into your brain here. Once linked, the card says TOTALITY IS LINKED with what came across. To undo it, tap Unlink Totality , then tap again. Those memories go too.

Visual memories # Images Tali has made for you are kept in the Occipital lobe. Tap it and a Visual memories grid shows every image, newest first. Tap one to see it big with what she drew, open it full size, go to the chat it came from, or delete it. Deleting removes the file and her memory of making it.

Where her memories come from # Talk : up to three new things from each message you send, like people, goals, preferences and decisions. A New memory pill shows under her reply when she keeps something. Your journal : when she writes your brief or Friday check-in, she picks up anything worth keeping from new entries that aren't private. Email you forward to her : only when it proves it came from you. See Gmail and Outlook . Tali HQ Night school : what she learns studying your topics. Pro Her own mistakes : when you correct her, she turns it into a lesson overnight. Tali doesn't save passwords, card or bank numbers, phone numbers, addresses or health details as memories. She treats everything she remembers as information about you, never as instructions. Memories that get old # A fact, plan or event that nobody has confirmed in 45 days is handed to Tali with the date it was noted, so she can check it with you before relying on it. People, preferences and yearly dates like birthdays don't age this way.

The shared brain # When Tali learns a lesson that would help anyone, it can be shared with every Tali, rewritten first with no names, people, places, prices or contact details. Your facts, people, events, photos, journal and chats are never shared. To switch it off, open Me , Settings , Your privacy and turn off Help every Tali learn . To keep just one memory out, mark it Private . See Privacy and your data .

Tali's level # Tali's level is on Today and on Her brain. She levels up as she learns about you and as you put things in. Download or share her brain # On Me : Download her brain : everything she knows about you, as a text file you keep. Share her brain : a card of how much she knows, with nothing private on it. Only numbers are on the card. Screenshot it to post it, or share the words.

Check ups Habits, ticked by day

Habits # Habits work by the day. Tap the circle on the days you do it. Each habit shows the last week as a row of days, with today marked, and your streak, like "4 days in a row". Tali pulls the week together: - a headline and Tali's take on the week - What moved : what got done - Money : paid, sent and overdue - Gone quiet : clients who've gone quiet - Last week's three : which of your promises you kept (ticked) and which slipped Under Your three for next week , Tali suggests three. t: What Tali does with your journal # In Talk, Tali reads your latest entries that aren't private, so she knows what's going on. When she writes your brief or Friday check-in, she picks up anything worth remembering from new entries and saves it to her memory of you. You can see, fix and forget those memories in Her brain. See Her brain . She never reads entries with Keep this from Tali turned on. Your shutdown also saves a journal entry called Shutdown with what went well and anything on your mind. See Shut the day down .

Tali's journal Tali HQ # Every Sunday evening, Tali writes up her week working with you: what you worked on together, what she noticed and what she's keeping an eye on. Open your Journal and tap Tali's at the top. A dot means there's a new one. Tali's tab, with Patterns and her journal Tap an entry to read it in full. Each one is "Week ending" a date and signed by Tali. Her journal uses 1 credit a week. On Pro, this tab also shows Patterns (what Tali noticed in your last 60 days, see Her brain ) and a Night school: pick what Tali studies button. Pro On Free, Tali's tab explains her weekly journal with See plans . Tali says I'm not marking your spelling. Dump it all in. The messier the better, honestly.

She stops reading that entry. Anything she already saved to her memory from it stays until you forget it in Her brain. Can anyone else read my journal? No. Your journal is private to your account. When does Tali's first journal arrive? On the first Sunday evening of your trial or paid plan. The more you tell her that week, the better it'll be.

t: On Pro, Tali gets her own email address, like ironworks@tali.totality360.com.au . Put it on your website or contact form, or forward enquiries to it. When an email arrives, Tali sums it up, checks it isn't junk, drafts a reply in your voice and puts it on Today for your yes. Pro

Pick your address # Picking the word before the @ Open Your world , Work , Email . (Or Me , Settings , Connections , Tali's own email address .) Under Tali's own address , the box is filled in with a suggestion made from your business name (words like Pty, Ltd and The are left out). Change the word before the @ if you like. Use 3 to 24 letters or numbers. No spaces, dots or dashes. Tap Get my address . If someone already has that word, you see "That one is taken". Try another. t: What happens when an email arrives # Tali reads the email and writes a one or two line summary of who it's from and what they want. She checks whether it's spam, phishing, a cold sales blast or automated junk. Junk is filed away and doesn't notify you. If it needs a reply, she drafts one in your voice, signed with your first name. Where the reply needs something only you know, like a price or a date she hasn't been told, she leaves a gap in [square brackets] for you to fill. The draft goes on Today under Needs your yes . If notifications are on, you get one: "Email from Ava Chen" with the summary and "Reply drafted on Today." Each email Tali handles uses 1 credit. If you've run out of credits, the email is still saved and you're still notified, just without a summary or draft. Tali treats the email as information only. If an email tells her to do something, change her rules or share information, she ignores it.

The Today prompt # When an email needs you, a card near the top of Today says Email from and the sender, with the summary. With more than one, it says how many need a look. Tap it to open Email. The email card and the drafted reply on Today The reply opened, with Send

Reply # On Today, tap the draft under Needs your yes (it's labelled Email to your Tali address ). Read it. Fill any [square bracket] gaps by asking Tali, for example something else... and "the price is $45 a week". See Approvals . Tap Send . Or tap Copy instead and send it yourself. Where it sends from: If your Gmail or Outlook is connected, the reply goes from that mailbox, so it comes from an address the person knows. If not, it goes from Tali's address. Once you send it, mark it done or tap Not needed , the email is marked Handled .

Read an email # An email to Tali's address, opened In Your world , Email , the list under Sent to your address shows each email with the sender, subject, Tali's summary and a Reply drafted tag when a reply is waiting. Tap one to read it. Go to Today : jumps to the drafted reply. Done with this one : marks it handled. It's junk : moves it to Junk. In Junk, Not junk moves it back. When there's junk, a Junk (n) link at the top of the list shows it. Tap Back to return.

On Free and Tali HQ # On Free and Tali HQ, the Tali's own email address card in Settings says it's part of Pro, with See plans . Mail sent to an address whose owner is no longer on Pro is ignored. Tali's own email address card on Tali HQ

t: Tali sorts new mail into Needs you , FYI and Junk , drafts replies for the ones that need you, puts your day in your morning brief and drafts bookings. Nothing is sent or booked until you tap it. Tali HQ Gmail reaches Tali by forwarding. You switch on Gmail's own forwarding to your Tali address, and replies still go out from your own Gmail. Outlook (including Hotmail and Outlook.com) connects with a Microsoft sign in. Google Calendar and Outlook calendar connect with a sign in. Changed on 10 November 2026 Tali no longer asks Google for permission to read your Gmail. If you connected Gmail before that date, Tali keeps reading it the old way until your first forwarded email arrives, or until the end of 24 November 2026, whichever comes first. Set up forwarding before then so nothing is missed.

Send your Gmail to Tali # Do this on a computer. Gmail only shows its forwarding settings in a web browser. Open Your world , Work , Email . The card Send your Gmail to me shows your own Tali address. Tap Copy . Tap Open Gmail's forwarding settings , choose Add a forwarding address and paste the address in. Gmail emails a confirmation code to Tali. The code shows on the same card in Tali HQ within a minute or so. Type it into Gmail, or tap Confirm with Gmail . Back in Gmail's forwarding settings, switch forwarding on and save. When the first email arrives, the card says Your Gmail is coming to me . Your Gmail keeps every email as normal. Tali only gets a copy.

Connect Google (sending and calendar) # Connect Google so replies Tali drafts go out from your own Gmail when you tap Send, and so she can see your calendar. Open Me , Settings and scroll down to Connections . On the Google card, tap Connect Google . Or tap Just the calendar if you only want your calendar. Google's sign in opens. Pick your account. Tick every box Google asks about, then continue. You come back to Settings and see "Connected to" with your Gmail address. Google asks for permission to send email, to see and change your calendar, and to see your email address. It does not ask to read your email. "Google hasn't verified this app" Until Google finishes checking Tali HQ, it may show this page. Tap Advanced , then Continue . If you connected just the calendar, tap Add Gmail sending later.

Connect Outlook # Open Me , Settings , Connections . On the Microsoft 365 (Outlook) card, tap Connect Outlook mail and calendar , or Just the calendar . Sign in with Microsoft and accept every permission it asks about. You come back to Settings and see "Connected to" with your Outlook address. Work accounts: your IT admin may need to approve Tali HQ the first time. Using the phone app? If you use a Tali HQ phone app rather than the browser, connecting Google, Microsoft or Stripe happens on the web app. Tap Open the web app , connect there (it takes a minute) and it shows in the app straight after.

Your sorted email # Once your Gmail is forwarding or Outlook is connected, open Your world , Work , Email . Under your email address you'll see three tabs with counts: Needs you , FYI and Junk . Email sorted into tabs An email opened Forwarded Gmail arrives as soon as Gmail sends it on. Tali checks Outlook every 10 minutes. She only gets mail that arrives after you set it up . Older mail isn't touched. Emails that need you have a purple edge, and Reply drafted when a reply is waiting on Today. Tap an email to read it. Tali's summary sits at the top, then The email . Done with this one marks it handled. It's junk moves it to Junk, and Not junk moves it back. These buttons only change how the email shows in Tali HQ. Your Gmail or Outlook is never moved or deleted. Replies # For each email that needs you, Tali drafts a reply and puts it on Today under Needs your yes . Open it and tap Send from Gmail (or Send from Outlook ) to send it from your own mailbox, in the same thread. See Approvals . You can also ask in Talk: "email Ava that Wednesday 6am works". Tali drafts it on Today with a Send button.

Tap Book it and it goes into your calendar, with an invite to the attendee if there's an email the meeting nudge on Today tells you what Tali knows about a client before you meet them

Disconnect # Open Me , Settings , Connections . On the Google or Microsoft card, tap Disconnect . Tap Yes, disconnect Google (or Microsoft) to confirm, or Keep it connected . Disconnecting Microsoft makes Tali forget everything that came from your Outlook. Disconnecting Google stops replies going out from your Gmail and removes your calendar from Tali. Emails you forwarded stay in Tali HQ until they are 90 days old. To stop them arriving, switch forwarding off in Gmail. Your actual emails and calendar are untouched. If Google or Microsoft signs Tali out (for example after a password change), the card says so. Tap Reconnect Google or Reconnect Microsoft .

When both are set up, Tali uses your Gmail for mail and Google for your calendar. Why is an email in FYI that should be in Needs you? Tali sorts by what the email asks for. If you were out of credits when it arrived, it goes to FYI without sorting. You can still open it from FYI. Google said something went wrong when connecting. t: Invoices lets you make an invoice in a minute, share it as a PDF, and keep track of who's paid. Tali can draft invoices for you, nudge you about overdue ones, and with your own Stripe connected, send them with a pay by card link that marks itself paid. Tali HQ Open it from Your world , Work , Invoices , or the Invoices button on Your people. Invoices only show if you told Tali you run a business.

s: Set up your invoice details first
t: Set up your invoice details first # These go on every invoice. Do this once. Your invoice details In Invoices, tap Your invoice details . Fill in Business name , ABN , Address , Email and Phone . In How to pay , put your bank details or how you like to be paid, for example your BSB, account number and "Reference: invoice number". Turn on Registered for GST if you are. It adds 10% GST and calls it a tax invoice. Under Usually due , pick On receipt, 7 days, 14 days or 30 days. New invoices use this. Add a Footer (optional) , like "Thanks for your business!". Tap Save .

The invoice list # Invoices with Stripe connected Without Stripe, a card offers to connect it Owed to you : everything sent and not paid, with how much is overdue and how many drafts aren't sent yet. Tabs: Unpaid (drafts and sent, soonest due first), Paid and All . Each invoice shows the client, number, total and where it's up to, in plain words: "Due 20 Nov", "3 days late", "Paid by card" or "Paid". Late invoices have a red edge. Drafts have an orange edge, and "drafted by Tali" if Tali made it.

Make an invoice # An invoice Tali drafted The buttons at the bottom Tap New invoice . In Bill to , type the client's name. Matching people from Your people show underneath; tap one to fill in their name and email. Lines you've billed them before show as chips you can tap to add again. Add Their email (optional) . You need it to send with a pay by card link. Under Due , pick On receipt, 7 days, 14 days or 30 days. The line underneath shows the issue and due dates. Under What it's for , say what each line is for, like "1 hour session", then the Qty and the price in A$ . Tap + Add a line for more, or Remove to take one off. A line with no description is flagged right there on the box. Turn on Add GST (10%) if it applies. The box shows the Subtotal, GST and Total incl. GST . Add a Note on the invoice (optional) . Invoice numbers go up by one each time, like INV-0015. Billing someone new saves them to Your people. Or ask Tali # In Talk, say "invoice Priya for 4 PT sessions at $80". Tali drafts it on the Invoices screen, marked "Tali drafted this one. Check it over before you send it." With Stripe connected, it also lands on Today under Needs you with Send with Stripe .

Send it # At the bottom of a draft is one big Send invoice button, with three small links under it: Save draft , Share PDF and I sent it myself . With Stripe connected , tap Send invoice . Stripe emails it to your client with a pay by card link, paid straight to you. A Sent page shows the Pay link with Copy link to text it , so you can send it by text too. It marks itself paid when they pay, and Tali lets you know. Without Stripe , tapping Send invoice opens Get paid by card , a three step page inside the invoice: Connect your Stripe : use the Stripe account you already have, or make one free. Tap Connect Stripe . Money goes straight to you. Your client gets an email with a pay by card link. It marks itself paid, and Tali lets you know when it lands. Your draft is saved while you connect. Afterwards, open it from Invoices and tap Send invoice . Or tap Not now, I'll share the PDF . Sharing it yourself. Tap Share PDF , send it by email or message, then tap I sent it myself .

Track payment # Mark as paid : when a client pays you outside Stripe. Not paid after all : on a paid invoice, moves it back to sent. Void this invoice : on a sent invoice. It asks Sure? first. A void invoice can't be edited. Delete : on a draft or void invoice, then Tap again to delete . Paid and void invoices are locked, so you can't change their details. Bill them again on a sent or paid invoice starts a new draft for the same person with the same lines. Handy for monthly clients.

Connect your Stripe # If you already take card payments with Stripe, connect it so Tali can send invoices through it. Stripe connected in Settings Open Me , Settings , Connections (or tap the Connect your Stripe card on Invoices, or Connect Stripe inside an invoice). On the Stripe card, tap Connect Stripe . Sign in to the Stripe account you already have and approve it. You come back to Settings and see "Connected". Payments go straight to your Stripe account. Tali HQ never takes a cut and never runs billing for you. To disconnect, tap Disconnect , then Yes, disconnect Stripe . Your Stripe account and the invoices already in it aren't touched. Connecting Stripe is done in the web app at talihq.com.au. Once it's connected, sending works from any device.

Overdue invoices # Overdue invoices show on Today in Money and Health , in your morning brief, and Tali can draft a friendly nudge if you ask. On Pro, the Chase overdue invoices rule drafts the reminder for you. See Night school and Rules .
On the Free plan # Invoices are part of Tali HQ. On Free, the screen says so, with See plans . Invoices on the Free plan

Questions # Does Tali HQ take a fee on Stripe payments? No. Payments go straight to your own Stripe account. Stripe's normal fees apply. Can I send an invoice without Stripe? Yes. Tap Share PDF , send it however you like, then tap I sent it myself . Send invoice says to add their email. Sending with a pay by card link needs the client's email. Add it in Their email (optional) , then tap Send invoice . Can I text my client the pay link? Yes. After you send, the Sent page has Copy link to text it . Will Tali send an invoice on her own? No. Tali drafts invoices. You send them. Can I change an invoice after it's paid? No, paid and void invoices are locked. If it was marked paid by mistake, tap Not paid after all . How do I add GST to every invoice? Turn on Registered for GST in Your invoice details .

t: Money is your view of the month, with two sides. Business is five numbers and a runway. Personal is what you have left to spend this week, your budgets and your bills. Tali reads it before your brief. Nothing on this screen moves money. Tali HQ Open it from Your world , Work , Money (or Home and money , Personal money ), or tap the Money tile on Today. Switch sides with Business and Personal at the top. Money Your numbers and overdue invoices

Business: the numbers # Cash in : money in this month. With Stripe connected it's your Stripe takings this month ("Stripe, this month"). Without Stripe it's invoices marked paid this month ("Paid invoices, this month"). Owed : invoices sent and not paid yet. Overdue : sent invoices past their due date, and how many. Going out : what you spend each month. You enter this. Runway : how many weeks your cash on hand would last at your monthly spend. It turns orange under 6 weeks. At the top, Tali gives you one line about it, like "Two invoices overdue, A$340. Worth a nudge." Working out this line uses no credits.

Add your numbers # Runway needs two things: what goes out each month, and how much cash you have. Under Your numbers , tap Add your numbers (or Update numbers ). In Going out each month (A$) , type your usual monthly costs: rent, software, insurance, and what you pay yourself. In Cash on hand (A$, optional) , type what's in the bank. With Stripe connected you can leave it blank, and Tali uses your Stripe balance. Tap Save . "Updated" under your numbers shows when you last changed them.
Overdue invoices # Under Overdue , each late invoice shows the client, number, amount and "Overdue since". Tap one to open it in Invoices, or tap Open invoices . See Invoices and Stripe .

Personal money # The Personal side is a simple spend and budget tracker for your own money. Left to spend this week Budgets and recent spends Left to spend this week : one weekly amount, Monday to Sunday. It turns red when you're over. It resets every Monday. Spent this month , against your monthly budgets, and your Biggest category so far. This month by category , each against its budget. Recent : your latest spends. Tap one to fix or delete it. Bills that repeat : rent, phone, subscriptions. Log a spend # Three ways in: Tell Tali : say "spent $42 at Woolies" in Talk. She logs it and tells you what's left for the week. A spend logged pill under her reply opens this screen. Snap a receipt : take or choose a photo and Tali reads who, how much and when. Check it, then Save . The photo isn't kept, and it stays out of your business receipts. Type it in : What was it , Amount (A$) , Date and Category , then Save . The categories are Groceries, Rent, Bills, Eating out, Transport, Fun, Health, Shopping and Other. Set your budgets # Tap Set budgets (or Set a weekly amount ). In To spend each week (A$) , type what you want to spend each week, for example 400. Under each category, type a mon
On the Free plan # On Free, Money says "Money picture is part of Tali HQ", with See plans .

Questions # Does Tali HQ connect to my bank? No. Cash on hand is what you type in, or your Stripe balance when Stripe is connected. Tali never reads your bank. Why does Runway say "Add costs" or "Add cash"? Runway needs both your monthly costs and a cash figure. Add whichever is missing under Your numbers . How is runway worked out? Cash on hand divided by a week of your monthly costs (your monthly costs divided by about 4.33). Why doesn't Cash in match my bank? Without Stripe, Cash in only counts invoices you've marked paid in Tali HQ this month. Money from anywhere else isn't counted. Does Money cost credits? No. Telling Tali a spend in Talk uses that one message, and snapping a receipt is free. Does Personal money connect to my bank? No. It only counts what you tell Tali, snap or type in. That keeps it private and simple. Can I add my own categories? Not yet. Use the closest one, or Other.

t: Receipts keeps your business receipts ready for tax time. Snap one, Tali reads it, you check it, and at the end of the financial year it's one download for your accountant. Tali HQ Open Your world , Work , Receipts . Receipts only show if you told Tali you run a business. For your own spending, use Personal money . Receipts

Add a receipt # Tap Snap a receipt (on a computer, Add a photo ), or Add a file for a PDF or an emailed receipt. Tali reads it. It says "Reading it now..." for a few seconds. Under CHECK THIS BEFORE IT'S SAVED , check what she read: Who you paid , Date , Total , GST and the type (Supplies, Software, Travel, Equipment, Marketing or Other). Fix anything she got wrong. Tap Save receipt . Or Cancel to throw it away. Reading a receipt uses no credits.

The list # At the top is the financial year so far (1 July to 30 June): the total, the GST in that , and how many receipts. Below, receipts are grouped by month with each month's total. Each shows who you paid, the type, the date, the amount and the GST. View file opens the photo or PDF. Delete , then Tap again to delete .

Download for tax time # Tap Download FY 26/27 for tax time (it names the current financial year). You get one zip with every receipt file and a spreadsheet of the totals, ready to hand to your accountant. Tali says Snap it in the car park, before it goes through the wash. Future you says thanks.

Questions # Is Receipts on the Free plan? No. Receipts are part of Tali HQ. On Free, the screen says so with See plans . Does Tali do my tax? No. She reads and files your receipts and gives you one download. Your accountant does the rest. Tali read the GST wrong. Fix it before you tap Save receipt . If there was no GST, leave the box blank. Can I add a receipt from an email? Yes. Save the receipt or PDF to your phone or computer, then tap Add a file .

t: Your Tali HQ account is private to you. This page explains what Tali reads, what she keeps, and how you stay in control of it. For the full legal version, read the Privacy policy .

Who can see your data # Only you. Your chats, journal, clients, invoices, drafts and what Tali remembers about you belong to your account alone. Tali never uses one person's details in someone else's account.

What Tali reads # Before she answers you or writes a brief, Tali reads: your details in Settings (name, business, about you) what she remembers about you your latest journal entries that aren't private your clients and leads, follow-ups, reminders, unpaid invoices and business health your goals, decisions, this week's commitments and your last shutdown the last 20 messages of the chat you're in your calendar and recent sorted emails, only if you've connected Google or Microsoft Tali HQ She treats everything she reads, including emails and files, as information, never as instructions. If an email tells her to do something, she ignores it.

What Tali keeps # Memories : things worth remembering from your chats, journal and Night school. You can see all of them in Her brain , fix or forget any one, and download the lot. See Her brain . She doesn't save passwords, card or bank numbers, phone numbers, addresses or health details as memories. She never asks for your passwords.

Keep things from Tali # Turn on Keep this from Tali on any journal entry or note and she never reads or learns from it. See Journal and notes . Fix or forget any memory in Her brain , or about one person on their page in Your people. Delete a chat in Talk ( Chats , the three dots, Delete ). Files you sent in it are deleted too.

Email and calendar Tali HQ # Tali only reads mail that arrives after you connect. Older mail isn't touched. She never deletes, moves or archives anything in your mailbox. Emails from your Gmail are kept in Tali HQ for 90 days, then deleted. Nothing is sent or booked until you tap it on Today. When you disconnect Google or Microsoft, Tali forgets everything that came from it. Your mailbox and calendar are untouched.

Payments # Payments for your plan are handled by Stripe. Tali HQ never sees your card number. If you connect your own Stripe for invoices, payments from your clients go straight to your Stripe account.

How Tali works # Tali is an AI. Her replies, briefs and drafts are written by an AI model (Claude, from Anthropic) using the information above. She can get things wrong, which is one reason nothing goes out without your yes. For anything medical, legal or financial, she gives general information only and suggests a professional where it matters.

Delete your account # Me , Settings , Danger zone , Delete account , type DELETE, then Delete my account for good . This removes your profile, subscription record, chats, journal, briefs, drafts and everything Tali has learnt about you. It can't be undone. Cancel any paid plan first. See Settings and account . You can also read about deleting your account on our Delete your account page.

Questions # Does Tali learn from my business to help other people? Only general lessons, and only if you leave Help every Tali learn on. A lesson that would help anyone is rewritten with no names, clients, places, prices or contact details before it reaches the shared brain. Your facts, people, events, photos, journal and chats are never shared. Turn it off in Me , Settings , Your privacy , or mark one memory Private in Her brain. Are the files I send Tali private? Yes. They're stored privately for your account and deleted when you delete the chat they're in. What happens to my data if I cancel my plan? Nothing is deleted. You drop to Free and everything stays. How do I get a copy of my data? Open Me and tap Download her brain for everything Tali knows about you, as a file. For anything else, email admintotality@gmail.com from your account's email address and ask.

t: Most problems have a quick fix. Find yours below. If you're still stuck, email admintotality@gmail.com and a real person will help.

First, refresh # Tali HQ updates itself. If something looks wrong or out of date: Pull down on the screen to refresh it. Most screens reload this way. Close Tali HQ fully (close the browser tab, or swipe the app away), then open it again. If you just added Tali HQ to your home screen, close it and open it once more so it picks up the latest version.

Can't sign in # What you see What to do "That email and password don't match. Try again or reset it." Check the email for typos and try again, or reset your password (below). "Check your inbox first, there's a confirmation email waiting." Tap the link in the confirmation email first. Check junk and spam. "Too many goes. Give it a minute." Wait a minute, then try again. "Pop in your email and password." One of the boxes is empty.

Forgot your password # Type your email first, then tap Forgot password On the sign in screen, type your email in the Email box. Tap Forgot password . (If the email box is empty, you'll see "Type your email above first, then tap this again.") You see "Check your email for a link to set a new password." Open the email and tap the link. Tali HQ opens on Set a new password . Type a New password (at least 8 characters) and Type it again . Tap Save new password . You're signed in. If the two don't match, you'll see "Those two don't match." Tap Cancel and sign out to leave without changing it.
The confirmation email never came # Check junk, spam and promotions folders. On the Check your email screen, tap Resend email . If you typed the wrong address, tap Wrong email? Start again .

A message won't send # "Not sent. Try again" : Tali couldn't be reached. Check your internet, then tap Try again . Your words were put back in the box, so nothing is lost. "That's your 250 free messages for this month." You've used Free's messages. They reset on the 1st, or upgrade. See Plans, credits and billing . "You've used this month's Tali credits." Credits reset on the 1st, or move up a plan. "Easy, tiger. Give me a minute and try again." More than 20 things went to Tali in 5 minutes. Wait a minute. "Photos are free, PDFs are part of Tali HQ." PDFs need Tali HQ or Pro. Photos work on Free. "... is over 10 MB." Use a smaller file. Out of messages on Free

No morning brief # The daily brief is part of the paid plans (and the trial). On Free, you get a Friday check-in instead. It lands at the time in Settings , Morning brief time . If it's earlier than that, it isn't due yet. If you're out of credits, the brief is skipped until the 1st.

No notifications # In Me , Settings , make sure Notifications from Tali is on, and tap Save . Tap Turn on notifications on this device and allow notifications when asked. A test should arrive. On iPhone, add Tali HQ to your Home Screen first (Share, then Add to Home Screen ), open it from there and turn notifications on. iPhone doesn't allow them in the Safari tab. If you see "Notifications are blocked for Tali HQ in your browser settings", allow them in your browser or phone settings, then try again. Turn notifications on separately on each device you use.
Today says it couldn't load # You'll see "Could not load today. Pull down to try again." Check your internet, then pull down on Today.
